title.label: Title
title.notes: Stable h1 element unique to the lot details page. Full title e.g. '2017 SUBARU WRX'.

lotInv.label: Lot number:
lotInv.notes: Inside the header, the lot number row has class lh-1-4 p-mt-3. The span.p-ml-1 contains the numeric lot number e.g. '99763515'.

laneItem.label: Lane/Item:
laneItem.notes: In the header row .lh-1-4.p-mt-3, 'Lane/Item:' is a direct-child span.p-f-w-500. Its adjacent sibling span (CSS + combinator skips text nodes) holds the value e.g. 'B/2574'.

saleName.label: Sale name:
saleName.notes: Stable id attribute. Returns e.g. 'DC - WASHINGTON DC'.

location.label: Location:
location.notes: Stable id attribute. Returns the location name e.g. 'DC - WASHINGTON DC'.

engineVerified.notes: Not present in this HTML snapshot. Appears on some lots under lot-details-information with label 'Engine Verified:'. Comment out or skip in scraper.

engineVerifiedNote.notes: Not present in this HTML snapshot. Only appears when engineVerified exists. Comment out or skip in scraper.

engineStatus.notes: Not present in this HTML snapshot. May appear as a lot-details-information row on run-and-drive lots. Comment out or skip in scraper.

transmissionEngages.notes: Not present in this HTML snapshot. Comment out or skip in scraper.

transmissionNote.notes: Not present in this HTML snapshot. Comment out or skip in scraper.

titleCode.label: Title code:
titleCode.notes: First lot-details-information block inside vehicle-information. innerText gives full code e.g. 'MD - Cert Of Salvage > 75% Damage'.

images.label: Images
images.notes: Thumbnail img elements inside the PrimeNG galleria component. Use getAttribute('src') to get the URL. High-res URLs can be derived by replacing '_thb.jpg' with '_hrs.jpg'.

copartLink.notes: Use page.url() in Puppeteer. No canonical link element in the DOM.

trim.notes: Trim is absent from this page. build-sheet-details has only 4 entries (VIN/Make/Model/Year). No dedicated trim label exists in lot-details-information. Comment out or skip this field in the scraper.

bodyStyle.label: Body Style :
bodyStyle.notes: Inside .cprt-panel-details-body the specs appear in a fixed row. p-half-flex:nth-child(3) is 'Body Style' based on observed order: 1=Abs, 2=Base Weight, 3=Body Style. Fragile to order changes.

runAndDrive.notes: No dedicated Run & Drive label-value row in this HTML. May appear as a highlights item text ('Run & Drive'). Comment out or skip this field; derive from highlights array if needed.

vin.label: VIN:

titleCode.label: Title code:
titleCode.notes: First lot-details-information block inside vehicle-information. innerText gives full code e.g. 'MD - Cert Of Salvage > 75% Damage'.

vehicleTitleType.notes: Derived from the second span inside the titleCode value div. Returns the type description e.g. 'Cert Of Salvage > 75% Damage'. The first span is the state code 'MD -'.

odometer.label: Odometer:
odometer.notes: Second lot-details-information block. innerText is e.g. '0 mi Not Actual'. Parse numeric value from first token.

odometerUnit.notes: Derived from the odometer value text. Second non-empty token is the unit e.g. 'mi'.

odometerStatus.notes: The nested span inside the odometer value holds the status text e.g. 'Not Actual'. The button inside has no visible text.

primaryDamage.label: Primary damage:
primaryDamage.notes: Third lot-details-information block. Returns e.g. 'Front End'.

cylinders.label: Cylinders:
cylinders.notes: Fifth block (child 4 is 'Estimated retail value', not in LotDetails type). Returns e.g. '4'.

hasKey.label: Has key:
hasKey.notes: Seventh block. innerText is 'Yes' or 'No'. Normalize: 'No' -> false, 'Yes' -> true.

engineType.label: Engine type:
engineType.notes: Eighth block. innerText includes engine description e.g. '2.0L 4'. listen-to-engine custom element has no text.

transmission.label: Transmission:
transmission.notes: Ninth block. Returns e.g. 'Manual'. under-carriage custom element has no visible text.

driveTrain.label: Drivetrain:
driveTrain.notes: Eleventh block. Returns e.g. 'ALL WHEEL DRIVE'.

saleDate.label: Sale date:
saleDate.notes: Thirteenth block. Returns full date string e.g. 'Fri. Apr 17, 2026 03:00 PM GMT+1'. calendar-trigger-wrapper button has no visible text.

highlights.label: Highlights:
highlights.notes: Child 15 (crashed-toys-condition-report custom element occupies child 14). Each highlight is in .highlights-item > span.p-d-flex.p-ai-center > span. $$eval returns array of text strings.

notes.label: Notes:
notes.notes: Sixteenth block. innerText is the notes text e.g. 'There are no notes for this lot'.

lastUpdated.notes: No 'Last updated' label-value row found in this HTML. Comment out or skip in scraper.

currentBid.label: Current bid
currentBid.notes: The .bidding-heading div has class 'amount bidding-heading separate-currency-symbol'. Its first span holds the bid value e.g. '$0' or '$1,250'.

buyItNow.notes: No Buy It Now price element found in this HTML. Some lots may display it; not present here. Comment out or skip in scraper.

auctionName.label: Sale name:
auctionName.notes: Same element as saleName. Auction name equals the sale name e.g. 'DC - WASHINGTON DC'.

auctionCountdown.label: Auction countdown:
auctionCountdown.notes: span.hide-on-stickybottom holds the 'Auction countdown:' label. CSS adjacent sibling combinator (+) finds the next element sibling which holds the value e.g. '6D 21H 9min'. Scoped to bid-information section to avoid sticky bar duplicates.

images.label: Images
images.notes: Thumbnail img elements inside the PrimeNG galleria component. Use getAttribute('src') to get the URL. High-res URLs can be derived by replacing '_thb.jpg' with '_hrs.jpg'.

copartLink.notes: Use page.url() in Puppeteer. No canonical link element in the DOM.
